criteria.text: Identifies that the Use of Proceeds allocations sum to $155,000,000, not the stated net proceeds of $150,000,000 (a $5,000,000 overstatement).
Calculates the underwriting commission as $9,625,000 (5.5% of gross proceeds of $175,000,000) and identifies that the stated $11,068,750 is wrong.
Identifies that 15% of 16,000,000 Firm Shares is 2,400,000 shares, not the 3,200,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
